items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: Mose Allison met us in the next town.

ctx.x: So Jimmy said, 'look. Let me tell you something, little boy.' Say, 'what is all this--you going around firing, firing, firing, firing somebody because of applause.' Now, we come to find out, that's when we find out that this guy Stan Getz wasn't nothing but a little faggot. And he started crying just like a little boy, man. 'Ya'll going
to leave me out here. You going to leave me out of the band," and all this kind of stuff. And the piano player he sent for You never could imagine--Mose Allison.
